note: Copy to wrapper.local.json in this folder (gitignored) and replace every <...> placeholder, or set $JSTACK_RETRO_CLAUDE instead. argv is the command that runs claude; run.py adds `plugin eval` and its flags. This example injects the eval billing key from a secrets manager and unsets the proxy and tool keys so the runs neither use nor see them. ["claude"] alone runs with whatever this shell has.
